title: Pure Vampire
summary: Vampire cards only, with generic Links and staples. Vampires are DARK Zombies that mill the opponent's Deck, steal their monsters and revive what they destroy. The 2022 cards lead. Vampire Ghost sends a Vampire card to search a Level 4 or higher Vampire and mill a small one. Vampire Fascinator, a Link-3, revives a monster from their GY onto your field and tributes a Vampire to take control of one of theirs. The Zombie Vampire is a Rank 8 that treats their monsters as Level 8 material. Vampire Familiar searches a Vampire monster and Vampire Retainer a Vampire Spell/Trap, and both revive themselves by sending another Vampire card. Vampire Voivode revives two of their monsters and negates effects of names already in the GY. Vampire's Domain grants an extra Vampire Normal Summon, and Vampire Domination negates any activation.
